method: 3 rounds alternating build A (before) and build B (after), one cold sample per route per round (see run.mjs --cold); medians across rounds. withoutConfigMs is the first request minus next.config evaluation; loadedSelfMs is own evaluation time of files loaded during the request, next.config excluded.

before.method: cold: a fresh next start per sample (boot-time route preload off, as on Vercel), with a Sentry DSN; first request timed against the fake backend (30 ms per Supabase call); 1 samples per route, medians reported. Files are CommonJS files evaluated during the request, with own time (compile and top-level evaluation).
